title: Pax Vaporizer 3D Screens – 3 Pack
description:
Replacement Pax screens

These replacement Oven Screens have been redesigned for the PAX Mini and PAX Plus, and fit perfectly inside of the oven. Easy to use and easy to remove.

If you’ve noticed a sharp drop in flavor or vapor quality with your Pax device, it might be due time to replace the screen.

Compatible with PAX 2, PAX 3, PAX MINI, and PAX PLUS.

Not compatible with PAX 1.
